articles.title: From historic golf gold to tennis medal miss: India’s biggest hits & flops at Asian Games
articles.description: India finished fourth at the 2026 Asian Games with 85 medals, including 21 golds, below its Hangzhou record of 106. Archery, hockey, cricket, boxing and wrestling delivered major successes, while athletics topped the overall medal count with 24. Tennis, badminton, esports, fencing and volleyball disappointed, while shooting, table tennis and rowing produced mixed or underwhelming returns overall.

articles.title: FIR lodged after 3 women journalists allege sexual harassment at Delhi protest
articles.description: On October 3, three female journalists reported instances of sexual harassment to the Delhi Police during a protest. These cases were referred to the Crime Branch for further inquiry. This protest, directed at Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar regarding alleged electoral roll discrepancies, resulted in the detention of hundreds, raising concerns regarding the police's handling of the situation, with opposition leaders condemning the use of violence and unauthorized protest measures.

articles.title: One casualty every 23 minutes: Civilians fatalities mount as Ukraine war intensifies
articles.description: In the first eight months of 2026, the situation in Ukraine has become increasingly dire, with civilian casualties and injuries rising sharply. Reports indicate that nearly 2,500 civilians have been impacted by missile strikes and aerial attacks, targeting both densely inhabited regions and critical infrastructure. As winter draws near, the damaging strikes on energy facilities have further jeopardized essential services, leaving civilians in a precarious state amid the continuing conflict.

articles.title: NSW planted bitou bush to stabilise dunes; it now threatens native ecosystems across 46% of coast
articles.description: Bitou bush was intentionally planted along the New South Wales coast to stabilize sand dunes. This plant has since spread extensively, covering 46% of the coastline and threatening native vegetation. Infestations of bitou bush replace native plant species and alter animal habitats throughout the region. A Threat Abatement Plan has been established to manage and contain this invasive species effectively.

articles.title: Sydney shopper’s A$4 cup turns out to be worth A$75,640
articles.description: A shopper discovered a unique Chinese libation cup at a thrift shop in Sydney, Australia. They bought the cup for A$4 despite its significant chip. After assessing the item, a Sotheby's specialist appraised it at A$20,000 to A$30,000. The item was later auctioned for A$75,640, significantly exceeding the original purchase price. This event highlights the potential hidden value in thrift store finds.

articles.title: Trump leaks senator’s number after row over clock-change bill: What’s the dispute
articles.description: Under the current system, Americans move their clocks one hour forward in March and one hour back in November. Moving the clock forward means sunrise and sunset appear one hour later on the clock. If the sun would normally rise at 7 am and set at 6 pm, the clock change would make them appear as 8 am and 7 pm. This gives people more daylight in the evening.

articles.title: Third edition of Green Energy Corridor to add 51,126 ckm transmission lines, 50 GWh BESS
articles.description: The Indian government has approved the third phase of the Green Energy Corridor to enhance renewable energy transmission. This phase will create over 51,000 circuit kilometres of transmission lines and significant transformation capacity. It also includes the installation of Battery Energy Storage Systems to store excess renewable energy. The implementation involves a mix of new projects and network upgrades managed by state transmission utilities.

articles.title: How landlord won tax relief on Rs 14.96 lakh demonetisation cash deposit
articles.description: The Bangalore bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) recently held that rental income already disclosed to the income tax authorities can be considered as an identifiable source of cash deposited into a bank account at a later date. Even where a landlord claims to have collected rent in cash, the subsequent deposit of that money cannot be disregarded merely because the rental earnings have already been taxed.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Vijay Deverakonda mourn veteran filmmaker Singeetham Srinivasa Rao
articles.description: Singeetham Srinivasa Rao, a veteran filmmaker, has passed away at the age of 94. He was known for his inventive storytelling across multiple Indian film industries. Celebrities like Vijay Deverakonda and Chiranjeevi have expressed their condolences and shared memories. His final film, 'Sing Geetham', showcased his passion for cinema and creativity at an advanced age. Singeetham's legacy includes significant contributions to various regional film industries in India.

articles.description: Chiranjeevi spoke out against the growing prevalence of artificial intelligence being misused to create disrespectful videos aimed at women. He highlighted the urgent need for action within the film industry and called for legal measures against the offenders. Jr NTR echoed this sentiment, voicing his outrage and intentions to take legal steps against those responsible. Vijay Deverakonda described the act as akin to digital sexual assault, demanding tougher legal penalties.
